rgb_authority_model.reason: A Bayer pixel has one sampled colour role and two absent colour roles; one authority label per pixel would erase that distinction.
rgb_authority_model.direct_stage2_reason: Stage-2 is a calibrated transform of the raw sensor code and should not be mislabeled as an untouched measured code value.

hardware_scaling.cheap_phone_rule: Use smaller compute workspaces and smaller persistence spans; do not change authority semantics.
hardware_scaling.heavy_hardware_rule: Use larger workspaces and spans or more throughput; compute power alone grants no evidence authority.
hardware_scaling.open_gate: v0.4 authority-region geometry must be made explicitly canonical and independent from hardware execution tiling.
